findings.passage: We deserve a democracy where every eligible Texan can vote freely, safely, and confidently. and where every vote is counted and matters.
findings.note: Quoted by Ballotpedia, labelled verbatim from his campaign website (Feb 19, 2026) under the heading about protecting the Constitution and the right to vote. General statement about ballot access and secure elections. It names no ID or citizenship requirement.

findings.passage: Texas elections should be secure and accessible. not confusing, intimidating, or designed to keep people home.
findings.note: Quoted by Ballotpedia, labelled verbatim from his campaign website (Feb 19, 2026). General statement that elections should be both secure and easy to use. It names no ID or citizenship requirement.
